BiblicalUsage: The foundation is the base of the wall. When the returned exiles set up the walls of Jerusalem, their enemies wrote that they had joined the foundations, and Zerubbabel laid the foundation of the house of God in the days of Cyrus.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe foundations are the part of the work no one sees, and the part that decides whether the wall stands: the returned exiles laid them first.
